# Follow a patch from failure to evidence

Original text walkthrough. Read one segment at a time and stop at each pause. The text below is the complete transcript and can be used as captions for your own recording. There is no required audio or video. A 5–10 minute reading-and-pause session is a provisional estimate, not a measured runtime.

## Segment 1 · Clarify behavior first

A note exporter accepts blank titles. A request asks to reject them. Before editing, preserve one input that reproduces the current behavior and one valid-title example.

**Pause before continuing:** Write the observable before/after difference.

## Segment 2 · Test the requirement

A test should check the result and state, not merely that a helper was called. A blank title must be rejected before the file is accepted as complete.

**Pause before continuing:** Name a broken implementation that a weak test would miss.

## Segment 3 · Inspect scope

Review the diff against the requested behavior. An unrelated formatting change or timeout removal needs its own justification and verification.

**Pause before continuing:** Write one specific review finding with trigger, consequence, and evidence needed.

## Segment 4 · Deliver and resume

A useful handoff names the candidate, original failure, rerun result, known limits, and one next action. A fresh session must not trust “all done” alone.

**Pause before continuing:** Close previous notes and describe which artifact you would verify first.
